items: 【❤Magnetic Cat Figurine Decoration】308i Bluetooth Keyboard (Cat Edition) comes with an adorable magnetic cat figurine that attaches easily to the keyboard. Mix and match to show off your unique style and add a touch of charm and comfort to your work or study space.

【❤Trendy Gradient Retro Typewriter Design】Features the most popular gradient-colored keycaps with a retro round typewriter-style layout. Smooth color transitions and a delicate touch combine to deliver both style and comfort, instantly upgrading your desktop aesthetic

【❤Stable Bluetooth Connection & Multi-Device Support】Equipped with Bluetooth 5.0 technology, this wireless keyboard offers a stable, lag-free connection within 10 meters. Compatible with Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices. Easily switch between three paired devices with shortcut keys (FN + Q/W/E).

【❤Compact 84-Key Layout with Multimedia Shortcuts】This cute keyboard features a space-saving 84-key compact layout while retaining essential function keys. Use FN key combinations to easily access homepage, music, email, and more. Lightweight and portable — perfect for business trips, libraries, travel, typing, or work anywhere on the go.

【❤Smart Power Saving & Quiet Typing】Features an intelligent power-saving mode that automatically goes to sleep after 15 minutes of inactivity — wake it up with any key press. Built with noise-reduction key technology to significantly reduce keystroke sounds — ideal for quiet environments like libraries and late-night work sessions.

【❤Perfect Gift Choice】With its adorable vintage look and modern Bluetooth functionality, this keyboard is the ideal gift for girls, kids, friends, or family. A charming and practical addition to any desk setup.
